verdict.rationale: Mollie documents shareable payment links that can be sent by email or chat and that open on Mollie's hosted checkout pages. A supplementary summary calls these links "no-code", but every primary citation describes creating them through the Payment Links API rather than from the dashboard. Missing for 10: first-party evidence of creating payment links in the Mollie Web app/dashboard without code, evidence of how quickly a new founder can start selling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
